messages:
elaine: Drafting a concise migration note for v1 -> v2 focused on model endpoint name changes and SDK shim guidance. Main asks: choose header name, confirm redirect semantics for POSTs, and list minimal snippets per SDK. Draft is at https://redwood.dev/r/mig-2123

sam: For correctness: POSTs must 307 so method and body are preserved; GETs can be 301. Also emit a clear header so infra and customers can detect v1 traffic.

anya: I'll take the TS and Python snippets. Plan: show recommended `apiVersion:'v2'` usage and a short `compat:true` example that warns on first use. Note: call signatures that relied on positional strings will be translated when safe.

diego: I'll add a tiny smoke test in the compat suite to ensure redirects keep method, body, auth header, and querystring intact. Suggest mapping a couple of popular names to v2-compat models (documented).

elaine: Proposed header: `X-Redwood-Deprecated: v1`. Add a short curl example in the migration doc to demonstrate header + Location on redirect. Example: `curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models -d '{"name":"x"}'` -> 307, Location: /v2/models, X-Redwood-Deprecated: v1.

sam: Also add a short FAQ: "What if my client doesn't follow redirects?" with guidance to update SDKs and a temporary compat flag.

anya: Snippet (TS): `import {Redwood} from '@redwood/inference'; const c = new Redwood({apiVersion:'v2'}); await c.models.create({name:'m'}); // compat: new Redwood({compat:true})` Add comment that compat is time-limited (~90 days) and logs a warning.

diego: Smoke test PR opened. CI failing on one case where query params were dropped; patch pushed. Once CI green I'll mark infra ready to deploy redirects to staging.

elaine: Assign owners: sam -> redirect rules + FAQ copy; anya -> SDK snippets; diego -> tests + infra coordination. I'll post the deprecation banner draft after snippets land. docs-bot: please create a tracking PR when staging is ready.

docs-bot: Draft PR created in docs-staging by @elaine.
